post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I could have contributed more in Game 3 by proposing successful missions or by being in the right position. Not taking advantage of Mission 2's information, where Diana was revealed as Merlin and her powers could have been utilized. However, the mission did ultimately succeed due to teamwork, and we should have built upon that momentum.

player_observations.Diana: Diana's Merlin role allowed us to gain valuable information about other players' roles. I believe she could have been more proactive in utilizing her powers to make a difference in our mission outcomes.
player_observations.Eve: Eve was quite reserved in her actions, and it was unclear whether she was actively trying to succeed or simply playing it safe. While she did contribute to our one successful mission, her overall gameplay could be more assertive.
